purpose: Low-cost N=4 exploratory screen of whether the raw TLS integrated spectral weight systematically separates sampled nupi=1 from nupi=0 BDI-labelled drives. This protocol is motivated by, but is independent from, the exploratory Gate A v3 four-point amplitude hierarchy.

selection_provenance.rule: For each (nu0,nupi) class retain two safe, mutually separated points from a fixed alpha/pi,beta/pi grid. No TLS response, Floquet-pair selection, or local matrix element entered candidate selection.

common_physical_protocol.full_model_pair_independence: No Floquet pair, B^(0) matrix, numerical Floquet index, matrix-element ranking, or phase convention enters the full-model preparation.
common_physical_protocol.readout: A_TLS=|2/(t_f-t_dis) integral[c_d(t)-mean(c_d)] exp(+i Omega t/2) dt|; W_r=integral |A_TLS(r)|^2 dr on the fixed ratio grid.

secondary_endpoints: peak location on the fixed detuning-ratio grid
predeclared_analysis.nupi_weight_screen: Compute medians within each sampled BDI class. Report median(W_nu11)/median(W_nu10), median(W_nu01)/median(W_nu00), and pooled median(W_nupi1)/pooled median(W_nupi0).
predeclared_analysis.screening_success_condition: Both fixed-nu0 median ratios must exceed 10 and the smaller of all four nupi=1 weights must exceed the larger of all four nupi=0 weights. This is a candidate-screen criterion only, not evidence of a universal invariant law.
predeclared_analysis.screening_failure_condition: If any primary weight condition fails, do not schedule N=6 confirmation or modify candidate selection. Report the descriptive N=4 screen and stop.
predeclared_analysis.interpretation_boundary: This cross-period stratified design fixes gT, gamma1T, common state, measurement ratio grid, periods, discard periods, and time-step density. It does not provide a single common-T causal comparison across all four BDI classes.

provenance.before_run: Publicly commit this protocol, response-blind candidate selection JSON, and N=4 production/audit scripts. Every result records protocol/script SHA-256, Git commit, UTC timing, command, and self-hash.
provenance.language: Prospectively frozen numerical protocol; never formal preregistration.
